name: Caleb Zheng
source:
The hot-headed rook of the Queen's Guard, Caleb is a man who is definitely a little rough around the edges. He's known for his quick temper and grouchy demeanor. But perhaps there's something more beyond this thorny exterior and a reason he always seems to push others away.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/steamberrystudio/gilded-shadows-a-gxb-sci-fi-adventure-otome-game]Kickstarter[/url]]
